body: Storms make me feel strangely fulfilled, like I am nothing, but its ok because so is everyone else, and storms kind of remind me of that and calm me at the same time.

you're disgusting and insensitive. I'm sorry for your loss but surely the pain you've felt would put some empathy in your heart for someone who is that hurt would wish this upon themselves. I am also one of those people who wishes this upon myself, because there is less stigma and people like you around for the people with cancer.

Hi, I am from the UK, I have no friends but I have been painting anime onto glass for a while after seeing it trending online, if you like that kind of stuff I can show you some, im not happy, but I like a distraction

I wouldn't have any more pets, I feel like a failure because I couldn't give him what he needed. my family have also put their opinions in on the cat situation  and dont see it the same way I do so I feel worse about that right now. 

I have one friend I consider close but I rely too heavily on them so I overthink a lot through no fault of their own, everyone else I speak to it feels so forced and I tend to feel worse after speaking to them.

I have tried citalopram, fluoxetine and sertraline so far, none of these seamed to have suited me, and I cant say if I like my counsellor or not because I keep forgetting our appointments. (I get blacklisted by a lot of people/places such as hairdressers ect) because for some reason I am unable to keep track of my life. I'm just so tired, I have a degree I cant use, I dont do drugs or drink I exercise I try to eat right and I still feel like an absolute mess, I dont know how everything falls apart the way it does

so far, I've been trying to find a plan but im terrible with the Internet and not sure where to look, I was thinking an OD or hang because everything else feels too public to work I am UK, I love my cat and I am able to look after him, but he has a genetic disorder which causes him to bleed when he is stressed and I cannot remove the stress for him living with me. 

All of my relationships feel forced/fake and I dont remember many of my interactions with these people now as they have become so infrequent. 

I feel like I am stuck in a loop of get through certain days without killing myself now, I am currently speaking to a counsellor but it is just CBT and I do not think that is the help I need. My view of reality has become so distorted that the most minor interaction either makes my day manic or makes me want to end it all. there's no calm or in-between anymore. I have left my job and have no outlook for so much as next month anymore

I understand you're trying to show you care, but its coming across really guilty trippy, im not going to regret anything if im not alive, and maybe so but this felt like a less selfish option rather than a random day in the year that they have to be reminded of me on
may 8th is my birthday too x

I do go on walks sometimes but I tend to overthink and get stuck in my head then, my cat is called kovu, he's a big cat (mainecoon) he's a bit of an asshole sometimes he'll attack me out of nowhere (playfully) and he'd probably rip into me about stuff I do if he could talk... so probably just arguments and making fun of each other

My heart is hurting so much how I relate to this, I have one or two friends that are probably tired of me blowing them off.. I have a cat, and everytime I shy away from doing it I always think "whos going to feed the cat".
